diff_profile.notes: Touches lib/test/run-parallel.sh (whole-suite coordinator), lib/test/modules/parallel-suite-runner.sh (test module), coverage-map.json, CLAUDE.md, two docs/internal pages, and .github/workflows/devflow.yml comment. Adds a bash SECONDS elapsed line + two stdout-only assertions + provenance annotations on five duration figures + a changeset.

phase3_findings.description: The two new assertions verify only that a digit follows 'elapsed '; they do not pin the degenerate sub-second lower bound (elapsed 0s) as a distinct named case. The residual-risk case the issue calls out is covered only incidentally by fixture speed, not by an explicit assertion. Criticality 3 (low value; current pattern already fails closed if the line vanishes or moves to stderr).

The match pattern '*"run-parallel: elapsed "[0-9]*' does not anchor the trailing 's' unit or reject a non-numeric remainder, so it would also accept a malformed suffix (e.g. 'elapsed 5x'). Minor loose match; not a correctness risk since the producer is a single printf with a fixed %ss format. Criticality 2.

assessments.prflow:code-reviewer: No issues at confidence >= 80. Core change sound and internally consistent: run-parallel.sh emits 'run-parallel: elapsed %ss' to stdout before the AGGREGATE_RC branch, so it fires on both CLEAN and FAILED paths (FAILED verdict goes to stderr). The two new tests capture stdout alone via 2>/dev/null and genuinely guard stdout placement. CLAUDE.md record-contract update's documented marker string matches actual output; not a documented_falsehood. Docs/workflow measurement updates are dated, run-id-attributed historical snapshots (past-time-snapshot exemption) and none contradict shipped code. coverage-map correctly maps 1808 to parallel-suite-runner. Added comments each name a specific wrong change they prevent. Change meets project standards.
assessments.prflow:silent-failure-hunter: No error-handling defects, silent failures, inappropriate fallbacks, or documented falsehoods. The elapsed printf uses only the bash SECONDS builtin (no external subprocess to swallow), is placed unconditionally before the AGGREGATE_RC branch, and exit status remains driven by AGGREGATE_RC. Tests correctly capture stdout alone (2>/dev/null) proving stdout placement given the FAILED verdict goes to stderr. Documented line format 'run-parallel: elapsed <N>s' matches shipped '%ss' output; measurement figures are historical observations, not code-contradicting claims.

Changeset and CLAUDE.md line 46 claims all match code. Measurement/provenance figures are dated historical facts, not claims about current code behavior. No documented falsehoods, no comment-drift, no comment exceeds the three-line/prevention-only standard for bound populations.
assessments.prflow:pr-test-analyzer: Test coverage adequate. Both new assertions capture with 2>/dev/null (not 2>&1) which is the correct load-bearing choice proving stdout specificity. Both exit paths covered: clean path (PSR_T6) and failed path (PSR_T3, SYN_MODE=notally-all driving AGGREGATE_RC=1). Degenerate sub-second lower bound covered implicitly since SECONDS is integer and stub fixtures run under a second (pattern matches 'elapsed 0s'). set -u satisfied (SECONDS always defined). No critical gaps. Two low-severity Suggestions: (1) sub-second '0s' lower bound not pinned as an explicit named case (test_gap, criticality 3); (2) match pattern doesn't anchor trailing 's' unit so would accept a malformed suffix (style, criticality 2).
